text:
incident-bot: ALERT: high GPU queue growth detected for pool 'spot-usw2-gpu'. 90th pct latency > 8s, queued requests rising > 600/min. AutoScale controller reported 3 consecutive scale failures. Pager: @oncall-ryan :rotating_light:

oncall-ryan: picking up. seeing large spike in queued inference jobs. customers complaining about 503s. any known deploys?

jamal: no deploys from infra. I can pull autoscaler logs. looks like cloud provider returned InsufficientCapacity for multiple scale attempts over the last 12m. also seeing a flapping set of spot preemptions across nodes.

sara: checking routing. traffic surge is mostly from embedding batch jobs from a single customer org id=org-893. Their batch window started ~10m ago. They are on hosted and not on dedicated.

ml-infra-lead: quick summary: spot pool lost ~24 GPUs via preemptions starting 1780001180; autoscaler attempted to add nodes but requests were throttled by provider-side rate limits and our internal scale caps (maxNodes=150). The fallback reserved pool 'reserved-burst' had no free instances (all pinned to other customers).

ops-elyse: looks like autoscaler keeper loop threw this in the controller logs: ``ERROR: scale_request_rejected: quota_exceeded: Requested vGPU quota 48 exceeds project quota 0`` — seems fallback pool lost its service account permissions during a recent IAM change.

oncall-ryan: ok — immediate mitigation steps?

jamal: 1) throttle embeddings from org-893 at the API gateway (quick rate limit) 2) mark low-priority interactive routes to degraded-mode (switch to smaller model variant) 3) attempt manual scale in other region (use reserved capacity in us-east-1)

eng-runtime: I can flip degraded-mode for routes `embeddings.bulk` and `generation.long` in the router config. Will do a canary change for 5% first.

support-anna: pinging account owner for org-893 to ask them to pause batch window. sending a templated message now.

deploy-bot: deploy of router-config v2026.03.14-emb-throttle triggered by eng-runtime at 1780001295 — canary 5% applied.

sara: rate limit rule applied: `org-893: max_requests_per_minute=30` at 1780001310. queue growth slowed but still at ~200/min. latency improved on canary routes.

ml-infra-lead: manual request to cloud support opened (case #CS-7654) to request emergency preemptible capacity in us-west-2 and removal of provider rate-limits on scale API. They've acknowledged. ETA unknown.

ops-elyse: investigating the IAM drift on fallback pool: deleted binding to service-account:gke-autoscaler@redwood-infra. Someone's recent infra change removed roles. Re-adding now.

jamal: while IAM fix completes, recommend activating a temporary soft-queue: reject new large embedding batch jobs with 429 + Retry-After 60 and enqueue a support ticket for affected customers. That will stop backlog growth.

eng-runtime: applying soft-queue rules for `batch_embeddings` at the gateway. Will log counts to #eng-sre for monitoring.

oncall-ryan: I'm going to do a controlled restart of the autoscaler manager to clear stuck requests: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/autoscaler-manager` (doing now)

deploy-bot: rollout initiated for autoscaler-manager at 1780001450 (commit d3f5b1f).

ml-infra-lead: autoscaler restarted; IAM role re-granted to fallback pool at 1780001502. Now attempting a manual grow of reserved-burst: requested +16 GPUs. Cloud returned "provisioning" for some nodes.

ops-elyse: note: provider still returning intermittent InsufficientCapacity for spot in us-west-2. but reserved-burst nodes are starting in us-east-1. routing needs to accept cross-region fallback — currently set to same-region-only.

eng-runtime: I'm toggling routing policy to allow cross-region fallback to us-east-1 for critical routes (`generation.*`, `embeddings.*`) for the next 60m. Doing a config push.

sara: cross-region traffic is flowing; latency for affected requests stabilized ~2.2s for canary. Queue drained to <50 in 18m. Good sign.

support-anna: notified 3 impacted customers (org-893, org-421, org-702). Provided status and ETA (working with infra; partial mitigation applied).

jamal: next: follow up to ensure autoscaler properly records failed scale attempts so we can avoid re-request storms. I see the controller retried identical requests 6x without backoff. Need backoff logic patch.

ml-infra-lead: agreed — filing GH issue: infra/autoscaler#412 (add exponential backoff + jitter). Will prioritize after this incident.

ops-elyse: cloud case updated: they can honor emergency allocation within the hour if we accept on-demand instead of spot. That will increase cost but will restore capacity faster. We have reserved budget to cover emergency on-demand for up to 6 hours.

oncall-ryan: approve emergency on-demand allocation. Please proceed.

ops-elyse: proceeding with on-demand allocation in us-west-2 and us-east-1. Adding nodes now.

deploy-bot: provider API returned success for on-demand nodes added at 1780001680. New capacity online in both regions. Autoscaler recognized nodes and allocated pods.

sara: queue has drained. All 503s resolved. Monitoring for 30m.

support-anna: customers confirmed service recovery and thanked us for quick response. No data loss reported.

jamal: remediation items: 1) fix autoscaler backoff 2) add playbook step for cross-region fallback 3) re-evaluate spot pool sizing and reserved-burst fill policies 4) add IAM drift detection for fallback pools

ml-infra-lead: assigning follow-ups to infra and eng-runtime. Will schedule a retro tomorrow 10:00 PST.

noncall-ryan: handing off to next on-call @oncall-lee — will post a brief handover and then close the incident if stable after 30m. :white_check_mark:

oncall-lee: taking handoff. I'll keep watch and escalate if metrics regress.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated at 1780001900. queue back to normal levels. follow-ups created: infra/autoscaler#412, ops/playbooks#89, security/iam-drift#27.

oncall-lee: thanks team. posting a short summary in #postmortems and will attach logs. good job everyone. :clap:

eng-runtime: quick note for postmortem: include snippet of controller log where backoff missing: ```2026-03-14T18:12:40Z ERROR scale_request_rejected: InsufficientCapacity; retrying immediately``` — that'll help identify fix points.

support-anna: closing customer tickets after confirmation.

jamal: moving to write timeline and RCA. I'll include decision points and cost tradeoffs for emergency on-demand.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED at 1780001987 (auto-archive scheduled).
